slides.texte_overlay:
Rewire your brain:
6 habits that kill laziness

1. Start with the smallest version
No time for 30 minutes?
Do 2. Starting is the hard part,
not continuing.

2. Put your gym bag
by the door at night
One less step between you
and the workout.
Less friction, fewer excuses.

3. Never sit back down
after you wake up
Feet on the floor,
straight to the shower.
The bed wins every negotiation.

4. If it takes under
2 minutes, do it now
The reply, the dishes,
the call. Small tasks
pile up into heavy days.

5. Do the hard task while
your coffee is still hot
The longer you wait,
the bigger it gets
in your head.

6. Replace one scroll
with one lesson
Swap 10 minutes of scrolling
for something that teaches you.
Same break, sharper mind.
